note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1955: contests in Ballymoyer and Mullaghbane, polled 2 June 1955; no party labels printed for the unopposed members. Returned unopposed. Printed "Lathbergit". John Quinn: no party label printed in 1955. At other elections he stood as Anti-Partitionist (Lathbirget, 2 June 1949, printed 'Anti-Partitionist': Newry Telegraph, 21 May 1949, p. 3 ("Newry No. 2 (Co. Armagh) Rural District Council (election nominations)"); Frontier Sentinel, 21 May 1949, p. 3 ("Newry and Kilkeel Rural Councils' Nominations")) and as Nationalist (Lathbirget, 5 June 1958, printed 'N.': Newry Telegraph, 24 May 1958, p. 1 ("The Council Elections: Newry No. 2 (Co. Armagh) Rural District Council (nominations)"); Newry Reporter, 22 May 1958, p. 1 ("Newry No. 2 Area (nominations)")).
